additional_info.subject: RE: ID0423024-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / P0  312567479/05 ] ENGIE VIANEO- charger fail safe mode CRM:02684000212
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
The customer reported that the charger is “charger fail safe mode”. Upon reviewing the logs, it was observed that the charger went
SCB offline
on
2025-04-16 at 19:30
. Prior to this timestamp, the charger appeared to be healthy.
Unfortunately, without an active SCB connection, our ability to provide remote support is limited.
W
e recommend doing an onsite investigate further. Several factors could be responsible for the charger being offline on the SCB, including:
Internet Connectivity Issues:
Siemens router failover function switching the WAN from cellular to Ethernet.
Mobile network issues, such as:
Disabled or expired SIM card.
Exhausted monthly data volume.
Weak signal strength due to changes in radio transmission conditions.
M2M contracts where the IP may not be enabled.
Router-Related Issues:
Teltonika router switching to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Hardware failure or software crash of the router.
We recommend carrying a spare router, couple of LAN cables & Spare SIM card during onsite troubleshooting to address any potential network-related issues.
Additionally, it is advisable to bring a Live Linux configuration restore USB stick, and prefer ready for a CFast flash drive, in case a full system reflash is required.
